Method of Attack: Trojanized application deployed on secure USB devices
Establishes communication with attacker’s command and control (C2) server
Fetches and runs additional payloads to steal documents and sensitive files
Collects details about USB drives used by the target
Self-replication through connected secure USB drives to propagate to other air-gapped systems
Injection of code into legitimate access management program on USB drive acting as loader
Compromising secure USB drives connected to the system to spread attack to air-gapped systems
Stealing files for espionage purposes and writing data on USB drives
Exfiltration of information when USB device plugs into internet-connected infected computer
Impacted Systems: Government systems in the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region
Attack Vector: Compromised secure USB drives with trojanized UTetris.exe application
